residuals.reason: A private root directory or image is deferred because the service consumes the host-managed release, runtime, environment file, and trust store; ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=true, and the locked non-root identity provide the measured filesystem boundary.
Bun 1.3.14 uses JIT-generated executable memory; MemoryDenyWriteExecute remains deferred until the exact runtime can pass the complete workload with it enabled.
AF_UNIX is retained for Bun and host-local runtime compatibility; unrelated socket families are denied, and removing local sockets has not passed the measured workload.
AF_INET and AF_INET6 are required for the loopback Caddy hop, hostname resolution results, and outbound MUD TCP or TLS connections.
PrivateNetwork cannot be enabled because the service must accept Caddy's loopback connection and open outbound MUD connections.
PrivateUsers is not needed for the locked non-root identity: user namespaces are denied, capabilities are empty, and NoNewPrivileges is enabled.
The analyzer's read-only RTC device comes from PrivateDevices' minimal private device set; the application has no device requirement and receives no device-related capabilities.
Bun's timers and event loop require ordinary clock syscalls; this group remains unfiltered until an exact-runtime syscall trace proves a safe narrower set.
A broad syscall filter is deferred for Bun 1.3.14 compatibility because the measured workload has not established that every @cpu-emulation denial is safe.
Debug syscalls are already constrained by empty capabilities, ProtectProc=invisible, and the absence of CAP_SYS_PTRACE; a Bun-compatible syscall denylist is deferred.
Module operations require privileges absent from the locked service; ProtectKernelModules and the empty capability set make an additional group filter inapplicable.
Mount operations require privileges absent from the locked service, while PrivateMounts and ProtectSystem=strict enforce the relevant filesystem boundary.
An @obsolete denylist is deferred until Bun 1.3.14 and its native dependencies are traced across startup, sustained traffic, and shutdown.
Privileged syscalls are already constrained by the non-root identity, empty capability set, and NoNewPrivileges, so an additional group filter is inapplicable.
Raw I/O is unavailable because PrivateDevices is enabled and CAP_SYS_RAWIO is absent, so an additional group filter is inapplicable.
Reboot syscalls are unavailable to the locked service without CAP_SYS_BOOT, so an additional group filter is inapplicable.
Resource escalation is unavailable without CAP_SYS_RESOURCE, while MemoryMax, TasksMax, and LimitNOFILE bound the service; a broader filter is deferred for ordinary runtime resource calls.
Swap control is unavailable to the non-root service without CAP_SYS_ADMIN, so an additional group filter is inapplicable.

A fixed IP allowlist cannot cover hostname-selected MUD endpoints while retaining the required Caddy loopback hop; address families, capabilities, and target policy enforce the networking boundary instead.
